data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Corporate Multi-Agent Context Architecture — The 4-Level Maturity Pyramid, 5 Quality Criteria, Intelligent Delegation, and Federated Memory Tiers
data.description: Enterprise architecture blueprint from Prompt Engineering to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture (Vishnyakova, 2026; Tomasev et al., 2026; Breunig, 2025): Context as the Agent's OS, the Cumulative 4-Level Maturity Pyramid (Prompt, Context, Intent, Specification Engineering), 5 Context Quality Criteria vs. 4 Context-Rot Modes, Klarna/TELUS/StrongDM case studies, Intelligent Delegation (Contract-First Decomposition, Privilege Attenuation, Chained Attestation), and 4-Tier Federated Memory.
